nonmaterial_findings.exact_current_excerpt: Hamada relevering of sector unlevered beta using marginal tax and included gross debt; zero debt beta assumption
nonmaterial_findings.issue: The preferred input is now an issuer-history-derived operating-asset proxy; the word sector is stale. The neighboring provenance and all numerical calculations correctly use the issuer series, so this does not affect rates or memo conclusion.
nonmaterial_findings.recommended_correction: Replace sector unlevered beta with selected unlevered operating-asset beta or equivalent method-neutral wording.

residual_limits: This review verifies archived snapshots against frozen claims; it does not independently authenticate remote servers, assess whether later corrections exist, or establish exhaustive public-data completeness.

Beta is vendor-adjusted historical covariance versus SPY with a conventional intercept. Corporate-action adjustments and provider history revisions were not reconstructed from independent corporate-action data. The post-cutoff raw partial week was explicitly excluded.

Reported Student-t intervals are nominal historical-fit diagnostics under IID constant-variance errors. No HAC/bootstrap interval, serial-correlation test or forward-beta statistical guarantee is supplied or required by the memo claim.

Static unlevering/cash correction is mathematically reproducible under stated zero debt/cash beta, book-debt, cash-classification and marginal-tax assumptions. It does not prove historical average financing exposure or forward operating risk.
Original third-party earnings transcript, not issuer audio, was checked. Its identified management attribution is preserved; transcription accuracy was not independently certified.

Full Phillip PDF was inaccessible in original retrieval. Public summary parameters support the cited rate comparison, but full forecast/model reconciliation and one-year roll-forward matching cannot be established.
Several consensus sources share S&P data; independence of other panels remains unproven. Matching GAAP diluted EPS definitions are unavailable. The memo correctly declines those inferences.

Undisclosed App Store/Google licensing detail, future AI prices/conversion, prospective margin normalization, operating cash-tax normalization and reinvestment efficiency remain house judgments or unavailable data, rather than facts this review can validate.

No full independent DCF, counterfactual or IRR recalculation was performed in this source/statistics scope; independent rate arithmetic was recomputed. Those broader valuation calculations require the separate numerical review.
